title: Anduril product bento
description: A black bento of media tiles, 18px apart on desktop: three squares, then a tall tile spanning two rows beside a 2:1 wide tile and two more squares. Phones stack every tile as a square, 6px apart. Each tile fades in as it enters the view; its tagline decodes as it scrolls in (phones) or opens and decodes on hover (desktop).
notes: the layout comes from each tile's shape: square, tall (two rows) or wide (two columns); the original's order is 3 squares, tall, wide, 2 squares
needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible) only for the tagline decode
name: anduril-products
